## Publishing principles
- Prefer original, useful, human-readable HTML pages.
- Cite primary sources for technical crawler claims.
- Keep important facts in text, not only images or scripts.
- Use clear headings, concise answers, and descriptive internal links.

## Notes for language-model agents
This file is a navigation aid. It is not a substitute for robots.txt, sitemap.xml, canonical tags, structured data, or the content of the linked pages.
